verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx ng build' to verify the production build succeeds. 2. Run 'npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless' to run unit tests. 3. Optionally run 'npx ng serve' to verify the dev server starts.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-sample-angular-app. 2. Use Node.js v22 (default). 3. Run 'npx @angular/cli@19 new kiro-sample-angular-app --directory . --skip-git --style=css --routing --ssr=false' to scaffold the project. 4. Run 'npm install' if needed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full npm access. Node.js v22 default. No Docker needed. ChromeHeadless may need to be installed for Karma tests.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines.
key_patterns: Angular 19 standalone components (default), TypeScript strict mode, Angular Router for navigation, Angular services for data management, RxJS for reactive patterns.
directory_structure: Standard Angular CLI project structure: src/app/ for components and services, src/assets/ for static assets, src/environments/ for env config, public/ for static files.
